metadata.title: Marvell stock plunges as a new threat hits the AI trade

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Shares of Marvell Technology Inc. (MRVL, Financials), a semiconductor company that specializes in data-center connectivity and infrastructure, slumped about 8% in premarket trade Monday as investors re-evaluated the prognosis for AI spending.The selloff followed comments from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei that advanced artificial intelligence systems should be developed more slowly. That's critical for Marvell, because many of the company's development opportunities are connected to the infrastructure being developed around artificial intelligence.A slower development cycle could ultimately mean less need for networking, memory and connectivity devices in AI data centers. The immediate situation, however, is murkier.Marvell will be at the AI Infra Summit in Santa Clara, September 15-17, where it will be showcasing its AI data-center connectivity and memory portfolio.That gives investors a near-term glimpse of how aggressively the corporation is setting itself up for further infrastructure spending.Wall Street is still broadly upbeat. According to TipRanks, the stock has 22 Buy recommendations and five Holds, with an average price target of $298.38.Investors are putting increasing weight on this week's conference. Marvell needs to demonstrate that demand for AI infrastructure is still strong enough to withstand a wider discussion about how fast the industry should be moving forward.
